description: Spanish_Genealogical_Word_List, recorded from the live corpus 2026-09-23 and trimmed to the sections a full-text search actually uses (the navigation sidebar, the number/date tables and the full A-Z list are dropped; nothing in the retained text is edited). It previously carried invented markers -- `v.o` for vecino, `d.to` for difunto, and a Latin given-name table -- none of which are on the page; the real page gives `difo.` and lists vecino with no abbreviation. `h.l.` and `h.n.` were genuine and are kept. The spelling-variation section is the page's most useful content for this skill and the invented version had dropped it.

# Spanish Genealogical Word List

## Language Characteristics

### Alphabetical Order

In Spanish indexes of surnames, it is important to note that prefixes (such as *De la Torre*) may be ignored in alphabetization. Be sure to search under both parts of a name, for example, *De la Torre* and *Torre, de la*.

### Spelling

Although Spanish spelling was standardized in the mid-1700s, scribes usually spelled words the way they sounded. In Spanish, the following variations are common:

***ch*** used for ***c***

***e*** used for ***i***

***j*** used for ***g***

***j*** used for ***x***

***j*** used for ***i***

***y*** used for ***i***

the addition or removal of an ***h***

the doubling of letters

Examples:

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ***chrisma*** | now written as | ***crisma*** |
| ***excrebir*** | now written as | ***escribir*** |
| ***lejítimo*** | now written as | ***legítimo*** |
| ***Méjico*** | now written as | ***México*** |
| ***domjngo*** | now written as | ***domingo*** |
| ***yndio*** | now written as | ***indio*** |
| ***Henrique*** | now written as | ***Enrique*** |
| ***religiosso*** | now written as | ***religioso*** |

## Key Words

| English | Spanish |
| --- | --- |
| baptism | bautismo, bauticé, bautizado (a), crisma |
| birth | nacimiento, nació, nacido (a) |
| death | muerte, defunción, fallecimiento, óbito, difunto(a) |
| marriage | matrimonio, casamiento, casé, casado (a) |
| name, surname | nombre, apellido |
| parents | padres |
| parish | parroquia |

## Abbreviations seen in the General Word List

| Spanish | English |
| --- | --- |
| Aa.M. = abuela materna | maternal grandmother |
| Aa.P. = abuela paterna | paternal grandmother |
| c.c. = casado con | married to |
| c.m.c. = contrajo matrimonio con | contracted marriage with |
| difo. = difunto | deceased |
| d.s.p. = defunctus sine prole | died without issue |
| h. = hijo | son |
| h.l. = hijo legítimo | legitimate child |
| h.n. = hijo natural | illegitimate child |
| i. = ilegítimo | illegitimate |
| l., leg. = legítimo | legitimate |
| o.s.p. = obiit sine prole | died without issue |
